name: Tichu
summary: Team climbing-shedding card game where partners cooperate to empty hands first and collect scoring cards to reach 1000 points.
rules_text: Four players in two partnerships sit alternating. 56-card deck includes four special cards. Deal 8 cards each; each may announce Grand Tichu for 200 points claiming they will go out first. Then deal remaining 6 each; until first play anyone may announce Tichu for 100 points. All players simultaneously pass one card face-down to each other player (three cards). Holder of Mah Jong leads first trick. Tricks are poker-like combos: single, pair, consecutive pairs, trips, straight 5+, full house. Higher same-type beats it. Four-of-kind or straight-flush 5+ is a bomb beating anything except higher bomb; can be played out of turn. Mah Jong can be 1 and grants a wish for a rank that must be satisfied if possible. Dog has no value, leads only and passes lead to partner. Phoenix wild or beats single by 0.5. Dragon highest single but won tricks go to opponents. First out gives last player's cards to opponents and gives own tricks to first out. Kings, tens 10, fives 5, Dragon 25, Phoenix -25. Double victory 200 flat. First team to 1000 wins.
rating_reason: Team shedding game with hidden hands and scoring, fits engine
reasons: capability: trading_between_players: no mechanism for a player to propose and a player to accept an exchange

capability: conditional_subsequence: the step list is flat: a whole BLOCK of steps cannot be chosen instead of another block. This is NOT a limit on conditional scoring or conditional updates: a single step can carry a `when` condition and a single operation an `if`, both arithmetic, so 'the poisoner scores if the choices match, otherwise the chooser' is fine
